verdict.rationale: Booking an audit through a vetted auditor network or in-house audit arm is a fair question for a compliance-automation platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions an auditor network, audit booking, or published audit timelines. The closest items are policy templates 'approved by former auditors' and getting 'audit ready', which are adjacent readiness features and do not show the vendor arranging the audit itself.

support.subject: As a founder, I can book the audit itself through the vendor — a vetted auditor network or in-house audit arm with published expectations on timeline
